description: This file defines a minimal API endpoint class 'CatalogBrandListEndpoint' that handles HTTP GET requests to list catalog brands. It uses dependency injection for AutoMapper and a repository interface to retrieve data, mapping entities to DTOs for the response.

classes.name: CatalogBrandListEndpoint
classes.description: API endpoint class for listing catalog brands, implementing dependency injection, route setup, and request handling.

methods.name: AddRoute
methods.description: Configures the GET route '/api/catalog-brands' to invoke HandleAsync.

methods.name: HandleAsync
methods.description: Handles the request by retrieving catalog brands from the repository, mapping to DTOs, and returning the response.
